## Description

Posts passive orders on a wider-spread venue and hedges fills on a more liquid venue when net profitability remains positive.

## Where it may fit

Cross-venue liquidity fragmentation and persistent net spread after fees; works only with reliable hedging and low latency.

## Vehicles

Crypto market makers, cross-venue electronic market-making desks.

## Required data

Synchronized order books and trades on maker/taker venues, fees, depth, latency, inventory, transfer/hedge constraints.

## Caveats

The displayed spread is not guaranteed profit: partial fills, stale quotes, venue outages and hedge slippage create adverse selection.
